purpose: ACCOUNT CONTEXT / ESCALATION RESERVE — not a student first-touch contact list. 990 people are LATEST 990-REPORTED (TYxxxx), never current.

tables.name: greek_990_entity_candidate
tables.role: review queue backing — ADMIN ONLY, do not render in drawer

financial_context_fields.source: total_liabilities, net_assets, contributions, program_service_revenue, investment_income, gross_receipts

financial_context_fields.rule: per entity: max(tax_year) where rich_filing_available=true; chapter latest_filing_year = max across non-parent entities
ENTITY-level. House corp / local / foundation serving one chapter = chapter-level context. NATIONAL_PARENT = org-wide; NEVER show as the chapter's.
financials are CONTEXT ONLY, NOT purchasing-power scoring; assets are restricted real estate / endowment

primary_stakeholder_rules.null_when: no non-parent linked entity has any officer
primary_stakeholder_rules.scales_with: more IRS TEOS zips parsed (3 of 12 used)

join_contracts.name: chapter_entities
join_contracts.sql: SELECT le.* FROM greek_chapter_legal_entity l JOIN greek_legal_entity le ON le.id=l.legal_entity_id WHERE l.chapter_id=$1 AND l.match_confidence='HIGH_CONFIDENCE'

join_contracts.name: chapter_latest_financials
join_contracts.sql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (legal_entity_id) legal_entity_id, tax_year, total_revenue, total_expenses, total_assets FROM greek_990_filing WHERE rich_filing_available AND legal_entity_id = ANY($entity_ids) ORDER BY legal_entity_id, tax_year DESC

join_contracts.name: chapter_officers
join_contracts.sql: SELECT * FROM greek_990_officer WHERE legal_entity_id = ANY($non_parent_entity_ids)

join_contracts.name: optional_view
join_contracts.sql: greek_chapter_990_summary (documented in .md §1b; NOT yet created — safe additive migration)

forbidden: any label implying a currently-held role
ui_labels.national_only_state: National organization on file; no chapter-specific legal entity found.

outreach_policy.default: NONE of the 990 layer enters a first-touch queue; it is escalation/advisory context
outreach_policy.eligible_if_ever_built: only the primary governing stakeholder (house-corp/foundation/alumni president or treasurer), advisory/escalation track only, gated behind demonstrated student demand
outreach_policy.students: reached via existing demand-first channels, never the 990 layer

null_behavior.national_only: neutral note; do NOT show parent officers/financials/address as the chapter's
null_behavior.no_entity: 'No 990 / legal-entity data found.' (~19% of chapters; valid outcome)
null_behavior.never: fabricate a person, role, or figure to fill a field

code_status.needs_merge: nothing — main current and deployed; no app/UI code changed

known_caveats: Officer data is LATEST 990-REPORTED, avg ~3.4yr lag, never current; label with TY.
primary_latest_990_stakeholder populated for 68 chapters (SEC officer subset); scales with more IRS zips.
Financials are entity-level; NATIONAL_PARENT financials are org-wide — never present as chapter-level.
A few chapters link multiple same-name same-city EINs (old+current registrations) — count via distinct if a single number is needed.
Chapter-designation coverage ~15% of roster; some same-city sibling entities remain in the MEDIUM review queue.
greek_990_entity_candidate (40,911 rows) is admin review backing — never render in the drawer.
Financials are context only, NOT a purchasing-power / spend-capacity score.
